city.title: Check your city
city.hint: It sets the time of your reminders and routine.

reminder.title: Create your first reminder
reminder.hint: Leave a note for yourself or for the other person. It arrives as an alert at the set time.

invite.title: Invite the other person
invite.hint: Until then, the app works just for you. Reminders, tasks and shopping are better together.

push.title: Turn on alerts
push.hint: Get reminders at the right time, even with the app closed.
push.hintInstall: On iPhone, alerts only work with the app on the home screen.

modules.title: Pick what you'll use most
modules.hint: Finance and Goals are optional. You can turn them on and off any time.
